messages.en:
{07 14 00}It's snowing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!


{07 19 00}When it's snowing, I don't
bother using an umbrella.

{07 14 00}Even though snow's made of
water, I never get wet! It's
like magic, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sajab lund, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!


{07 19 00}Kui sajab lund, ei viitsi
ma vihmavarju kasutada.

{07 14 00}Kuigi lumi on tehtud veest,
ma ei saa kunagi märjaks!
See on nagu võlu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Good morning{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
How are you, {04 1f 00}?

{07 00 00}First thing I saw when I
woke up this morning was
snow outside my window.
{07 0d 00}Before I even knew it, I
was outside making snowmen,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tere hommikust{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
Kuidas läheb, {04 1f 00}?

{07 00 00}Esimene asi, mida ma täna
hommikul ärgates nägin,
oli lumi mu akna taga.
{07 0d 00}Enne kui arugi sain, olin
ma väljas lumememmesid
tegemas, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
Everyone knows it's cold on
snowy days, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
It's common sense.
{07 0b 00}Still, I'm not sure why,{01 00 00 0f 00} but
{07 14 00}snowy days always make me
feel warm inside.
messages.et:
Kõik teavad, et lumistel
päevadel on külm, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
See on elementaarne.
{07 0b 00}Ikkagi, ma ei tea, miks,{01 00 00 0f 00} aga
{07 14 00}lumised päevad teevad mu
seest soojaks.

{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tere seal{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
Nii, {04 00 00}... Milline
suurepärane päev, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0b 00}Kas sulle ei meeldi
sammude heli{01 00 00 05 00} lumel,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Mulle meeldib {01 00 00 05 00}nii väga!{01 00 00 0f 00} Ma
võiksin igavesti trampida!
{07 0d 00}Krõmps,{01 00 00 05 00} krõmps,{01 00 00 05 00} krõmps!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hello, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}. {01 00 00 0a 00}Brrr!
It sure is chilly today,
isn't it!
{07 0e 00}Do you suppose that's
because it's snowing?{07 00 00}

Or.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}do you think maybe it's
snowing because it's cold?
Which is it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Tere, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}. {01 00 00 0a 00}Brrr!
Täna on küll jahe,
kas pole!
{07 0e 00}Kas sa arvad, et see on
sellepärast, et sajab?{07 00 00}

Või.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}arvad sa, et ehk sajab
lund, sest on külm?
Kumb see on, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
Let me ask, {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0b 00}Have you ever looked really
closely at a snowflake?
{07 0a 00}They're so delicate and
fragile,{01 00 00 05 00} and so hard to
hold on to.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}I{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 13 00}I wish I could
be like that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Las ma küsin, {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0b 00}Kas sa oled lumehelvest
väga lähedalt vaadanud?
{07 0a 00}Nad on nii õrnad ja
haprad,{01 00 00 05 00} ja neid on raske
kinni hoida.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Ma{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 13 00}Soovin, et saaksin
olla selline, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Good evening, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}


You be sure to wrap up
extra snug when you go to
bed tonight, OK?
It's going to be a chilly
one, and you don't want to
catch a cold, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Tere õhtust, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}


Mässi end täna öösel
magama minnes eriti
soojalt sisse, eks?
See saab olema jahe öö
ja sa ei taha külmetust
saada, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}It's so quiet{01 07 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}


All the daily hustle and
bustle seems quieter when
it's snowing out.
{07 0b 00}Why is that?{01 01 00}
{07 19 00}All that snow must muffle
the noise.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}On nii vaikne{01 07 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}


Kogu igapäevane sagin ja
melu tundub vaiksem, kui
väljas sajab lund.
{07 0b 00}Miks see nii on?{01 01 00}
{07 19 00}Kogu see lumi peab müra
summutama.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Good evenin', {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
It's so dark{01 00 00 05 00} and so chilly!

{07 07 00}I can't believe you're
dressed so lightly!

{07 14 00}Promise me you won't catch
a cold, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Tere õhtust, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
On nii pime{01 00 00 05 00} ja nii jahe!

{07 07 00}Ma ei suuda uskuda, et sa
oled nii kergelt riides!

{07 14 00}Luba mulle, et sa ei
külmeta, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Ooops!{01 00 00 0f 00} Look at the time!
It's already {04 08 00} o'clock!{07 00 00}

{07 14 00}I was just enjoying the
snow,{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 17 00}and I lost track of
time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Ohhoo!{01 00 00 0f 00} Vaata kella!
On juba {04 08 00}!{07 00 00}

{07 14 00}Ma lihtsalt nautisin
lund,{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 17 00}ja kaotasin ajataju,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Isn't it a lovely night{01 07 00}?
{07 00 00}It's still snowing, too.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

It snowed all day, and it
doesn't look like it'll stop
anytime soon, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}I wonder if the sky ever
runs out of snow.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Kas pole armas öö{01 07 00}?
{07 00 00}Ja ikka veel sajab lund.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

Sadas terve päeva ja ei
paista, et see niipea
lõpeks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}Huvitav, kas taevast saab
kunagi lumi otsa.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
